gloss_en: Chashmal — the kabbalistic luminous 'garment' (malbush, equal in gematria to chashmal) from Ezekiel's vision, expounded as chash-mal ('silent-speaking'/'silence-circumcision'): the protective enclothing level linked to circumcision (milah), to the kelipah of Nogah that can be absorbed into holiness, and to 'speaking truth in one's heart' that clothes and guards faith (as tefillin straps)
